resources.string: Use phone-friendly memory and concurrency options for local Gradle builds

Applies only to the default Gradle user home on this device, starting with the next build. Turning this off restores project/user defaults and keeps your selections here. Custom Gradle user homes or explicit build arguments take priority.
Choose options and tap Save. Canceling or dismissing this panel changes nothing. You can save options even while optimization is off.
Maximum Gradle JVM heap, not a total build memory limit. Compilers and other processes use additional memory.
Prefer reusing the Gradle process. Survival after PRoot exits or the system reclaims it is not guaranteed.
Allow eligible project tasks to run concurrently, potentially using more memory.
Limit the number of concurrent Gradle workers.
Maximum JVM heap for Gradle Test tasks. Test processes still use additional memory.
Could not save mobile build settings due to a possible configuration conflict or write failure. Check the local container and Gradle configuration, then try again.
